subject: pri-af-to
title: PRI.AF.TD.------ACC.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 115 (T(AF)M-19). PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. The title names PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics) and AF-CON (affinity convergence). From INFO-DY: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From AF-CON: C-INFO (composite information). From MT-INTR: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From DYM-F: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From PHY-U-P: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From WO-EXP-PRI: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From PROG-CONT: POL-DYM (political dynamics).
